summary: FASE 3.3 (Public certificate front-cover PREVIEW) — ALL BACKEND + FRONTEND TESTS PASS. Backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_fase3_3_preview.py: 17/17 PASS in 5.6s. Read-only regressions: POST /api/verify with fake AZR-GEM-2026-999999 => generic not_found with NO preview_token; /api/verify/qr/resolve invalid => token_valid=false; /api/settings/public whatsapp=6287812128884 + enabled=true; /api/legality empty. Preview E2E: created 1 TEST_ Corundum/Blue Sapphire gemstone => issued cert AZR-GEM-2026-000015 => POST /api/verify returned status=valid + certificate.preview_token (JWT). GET /api/verify/preview?t=<token> => HTTP 200 image/png with Cache-Control: public, max-age=900, immutable; PNG magic bytes present; body >1KB (rasterised at 630x893 in the browser). Preview JWT decode confirmed payload keys EXACTLY {sub, ver, type, iat, exp} with type='cert_preview' and ver=1; no security_code/qr_token/owner/ObjectId leakage anywhere (checked with a 24-hex regex). QR verification also returns preview_token and never leaks secrets. Reissue E2E: POST /api/admin/certificates/{uuid}/reissue with a valid IssueIn payload created version 2 (same number AZR-GEM-2026-000015 as current); /api/verify returned version=2 and a fresh preview_token whose JWT ver=2; GET /api/verify/preview with the v2 token returned PNG 200; and the v1 (archived) preview_token now returns HTTP 404 (endpoint gates on is_current). Invalid/garbled tokens => 404, empty/unsigned => 404/422 (no data leak). Counter drift: precondition last_number=14 -> after issuance = 15 -> after 3 verifications the counter remained 15 (verify does not touch the counter). MANDATORY CLEANUP + COUNTER RESTORE: certificates (both v1+v2), gemstone, verification_tokens purged; counters.certificate:{year=2026}.last_number restored to 14; final DB state asserted certificates==0, gemstones==0, last_number==14 => next real cert will be AZR-GEM-2026-000015. FRONTEND (Playwright, cert issued temporarily then removed): DESKTOP 1920x1080 successful manual verification shows premium 2-column layout — [data-testid=verify-preview] with [data-testid=verify-preview-image] whose src is https://<host>/api/verify/preview?t=<jwt>, image loaded (natural 630x893), certificate number 'AZR-GEM-2026-000015' rendered in both preview and Basic Info column. [data-testid=verify-view-digital] click opens [data-testid=verify-viewer-modal]; [data-testid=verify-viewer-close] closes it. MOBILE 390x844 same successful verification renders stacked (status -> preview -> info -> details), NO horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth). Invalid code (wrong security code) => no preview card ([data-testid=verify-preview] count == 0). GRACEFUL FALLBACK: aborting the /api/verify/preview request via page.route causes [data-testid=verify-preview-fallback] to render with 'Pratinjau sertifikat tidak tersedia' (ID) and the rest of the verification details STILL render (cert number present); the 'Lihat Sertifikat Digital' button is correctly hidden while fallback is shown. i18n toggle EN => preview label switches to 'Certificate Preview' and the button switches to 'VIEW DIGITAL CERTIFICATE'. Zero console errors during runs. Screenshots at /app/test_reports/fase33_desktop_verified.png, fase33_mobile_verified.png.
critical_code_review_comments: services/preview.py — JWT payload is minimal (sub/ver/type/iat/exp) and TTL is 20 minutes; keyed on cert.uuid + version so a token minted before a reissue automatically becomes non-current and the preview endpoint refuses it (validated by test_10). Solid design.

api/verify.py — preview endpoint correctly returns 404 for both bad-token and non-current/revoked cert, 503 on render failure, and reuses the per-IP _rate_limit shared with /api/verify (20/60s). Cache-Control header is set to public, max-age=900, immutable — acceptable because the response is keyed on a signed short-lived token; still, consider Vary: Cookie or Cache-Control: private if you later attach any user-scoped headers.

services/verification.py — _build_public_certificate wraps create_preview_token in try/except so verification will not break if minting ever fails; independently confirmed (verify.py still returns full JSON when preview endpoint 503s).

api/certificates.py — reissue endpoint reuses IssueIn as its request model, which requires gemstone_id. That's a UX surprise (the caller already has {uuid} in the URL) but not a security bug. Consider a ReissueIn model that defaults gemstone_id from the existing cert to reduce client friction.

Same non-blocking notes still apply from iterations 7/8: PUBLIC_BASE_URL is unset in /app/backend/.env so QR uses the preview host (documented behaviour); the api/certificates.py PDF endpoint silently swallows SettingsRepository failures.
No production RCA. Preview image loads first-try; no rate-limit false positives during tests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite /app/backend/tests/test_fase3_3_preview.py (17 tests, ~6s) should be run with '-o addopts=' (avoid xdist parallelism racing cleanup). Requires pyjwt (already in backend deps) + JWT_SECRET/JWT_ALGORITHM from backend/.env for token payload assertion. Reissue payload MUST include gemstone_id (backend reuses IssueIn model). Preview endpoint gates on cert.is_current: archived tokens 404 even if their JWT still decodes and hasn't expired. Cache-Control on preview response is public,max-age=900,immutable. Frontend seed/cleanup helper: python /app/tests/fase3_3_seed.py seed|cleanup.
rca of the issue: No production RCA. Two initial test-only misses were self-fixed in the same pass: (a) reissue payload needed gemstone_id (test_09), (b) reissue response omits security_code so the test now fetches it from db.verification_tokens by verification_uuid to complete the flow.
